description:
Learn to identify birds yourself, by sight and by sound.

Most bird apps name the bird for you. Motmot trains you to do it on your own. Pick a country and a level, and it quizzes you with real photos, videos and bird songs and calls of the species that actually live there. Free, open source and without ads.

FOR EVERY BIRDER
Start with the common garden birds and work up through five levels: Beginner, Novice, Advanced, Pro and Expert. At Expert you type the name yourself. Focus on one family, such as warblers, gulls or raptors, or on the species you keep mixing up.

BIRD SONGS AND CALLS
Sound quizzes use recordings from xeno-canto, so you can learn birdsong for your local patch or practise calls before a trip.

ANY COUNTRY IN THE WORLD
Quizzes are built from the bird list of each country and region, so you practise the species you will really see. Ideal before a birding holiday.

LEARN FROM YOUR MISTAKES
• Tricky Birds remembers which species you confuse and gives you extra practice on them
• Compare lookalikes side by side after a wrong answer
• My Checklist tracks every species you recognise and miss

PLAY TOGETHER
• Daily Challenge: a new quiz every day
• Country Challenge and the National League: climb the leaderboard for your country
• Survival: one wrong answer and your run is over
• Live multiplayer: challenge friends in real time
• Flocks: bird clubs and friends get a private group with a shared weekly quiz

YOUR LANGUAGE
The app speaks English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Japanese, and shows bird names in more than 75 languages or as scientific names.

Whether you are learning the birds in your garden, getting ready for a bird survey or sharpening years of fieldcraft, Motmot helps you recognise more birds with confidence.

How many birds can you identify?
